title: AWS Bedrock Tools Integration
summary: This module provides a collection of tools for CrewAI agents to interact with various AWS Bedrock services, including invoking agents, retrieving information from knowledge bases, and utilizing browser and code interpreter functionalities.

nodes.label: CrewAI Agent
nodes.title: CrewAI Agent
nodes.description: An intelligent agent within the CrewAI framework that leverages specialized tools to perform tasks.

nodes.label: Invoke Bedrock Agent
nodes.title: Bedrock Agent Invoker
nodes.description: Allows CrewAI agents to invoke a pre-configured AWS Bedrock Agent, sending a query and receiving a completion for complex tasks.

nodes.label: Retrieve from Bedrock Knowledge Base
nodes.title: Bedrock KB Retriever
nodes.description: Enables querying an Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base to retrieve relevant documents and information based on a user query for RAG.

nodes.label: Create Bedrock Browser Tools
nodes.title: Bedrock Browser Toolkit Factory
nodes.description: Generates a toolkit providing browser automation functionalities, integrated with AWS Bedrock services for web interaction.

nodes.label: Create Bedrock Code Interpreter Tools
nodes.title: Bedrock Code Interpreter Toolkit Factory
nodes.description: Generates a toolkit offering code execution and interpretation capabilities, powered by AWS Bedrock's code interpreter.

nodes.label: AWS Bedrock Agent Service
nodes.title: Bedrock Agent Service
nodes.description: The managed AWS service responsible for hosting and executing Bedrock Agents, processing complex tasks and workflows.

nodes.label: AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base Service
nodes.title: Bedrock Knowledge Base
nodes.description: The AWS service for managing, storing, and querying enterprise knowledge bases for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) applications.

nodes.label: AWS Bedrock Browser Service
nodes.title: Bedrock Browser Service
nodes.description: The underlying AWS Bedrock capability that provides browser automation and web interaction functionalities for agents.

nodes.label: AWS Bedrock Code Interpreter Service
nodes.title: Bedrock Code Interpreter
nodes.description: The underlying AWS Bedrock capability that provides a secure environment for code execution and interpretation for agents.

nodes.label: Boto3 AWS SDK
nodes.title: Boto3 AWS SDK
nodes.description: The official Python SDK for Amazon Web Services, used by these tools to programmatically interact with Bedrock services.

groups.label: Bedrock Tools
groups.title: Core Bedrock Tools
groups.description: The primary tools provided by this module for interacting with AWS Bedrock services from CrewAI agents.

groups.label: AWS Bedrock Services
groups.title: External AWS Bedrock Services
groups.description: The specific AWS Bedrock services that these tools integrate with to provide AI capabilities.
